## Validation

- [ ] Protocol build/typecheck if shared contracts changed
- [ ] Daemon typecheck/build/tests if daemon behavior changed
- [ ] CLI typecheck/build if CLI changed
- [ ] Web typecheck/lint if dashboard changed
- [ ] Manual or API smoke when process, access, persistence or realtime behavior changed

## Safety Notes

- [ ] No `.deskcue-data`, local database, logs, tokens or secrets committed
- [ ] Public docs stay self-contained and do not reference private planning files
